Q: How to parse list of models with Pydantic A:

My Answer is syntactic sugar to @Maxim Suslov's Answer above.

Use Root Model for Validation

from pydantic import BaseModel, RootModel

class User(BaseModel):
  name: str
  age: int

class PersonList(RootModel[list[User]]):
    pass

data = [{"name": "user1", "age": 15}, {"name": "user2", "age": 28}]
persons = PersonList(data)

print(persons.root[0]) # outputs the first User class instance that's been validated
print(persons.model_dump()) # serializes into a list of dictionaries

This approach mainly allows you to pass data as is to a Pydantic class. I primarily use this approach in API endpoint.

Q: How to read XML into an ADODB.Stream object from the output of a SQL stored procedure that execs query FOR XML Auto A:

This is a test: saving the xml as utf-8 without BOM

Sub Test_STORED_PROCEDURE()
On Error GoTo ExceptionHandling

Dim sSQL As String, sLine As String, sLineSQL As String, sCn As String, SoundName As String, sChecCom As String, arr_str_command() As String, arr_str_lines() As String, i As Integer, j As Integer, iCount As Integer, bDbg As Boolean, b As Byte
bDbg = True

sCn = "Provider=SQLOLEDB;Data Source=01.2.3.4;Initial Catalog=tempdb;User Id=MyUserName;Password=MyPassword;"

Dim miStream As ADODB.Stream
Dim strText As String

'Create new DOMDocument
Dim xmlDoc As MSXML2.DOMDocument60
Set xmlDoc = New DOMDocument60
With xmlDoc
    .async = False
    .preserveWhiteSpace = True
    .validateOnParse = False
    .resolveExternals = False
End With

sSQL = "SET NOCOUNT ON" & vbCrLf
sSQL = sSQL & "USE [tempdb]" & vbCrLf
sSQL = sSQL & "IF EXISTS(SELECT Name FROM SysObjects" & vbCrLf
sSQL = sSQL & "      WHERE Name = 'TestProcedureName' AND Type = 'P')" & vbCrLf
sSQL = sSQL & "DROP PROC TestProcedureName;" & vbCrLf
sSQL = sSQL & "-- Creating stored procedure." & vbCrLf
sSQL = sSQL & "CREATE PROCEDURE TestProcedureName @VarPrice money  " & vbCrLf
sSQL = sSQL & "   AS  " & vbCrLf
sSQL = sSQL & "   BEGIN  " & vbCrLf
sSQL = sSQL & "      SET NOCOUNT ON" & vbCrLf
sSQL = sSQL & "      SELECT ProductName, Price" & vbCrLf
sSQL = sSQL & "        FROM (" & vbCrLf
sSQL = sSQL & "          VALUES ('Clamp', 12.48), ('Screwdriver', 3.17), ('Tire Bar', 4.10), ('Corchete 3 mm', 0.52)" & vbCrLf
sSQL = sSQL & "        ) t1 (ProductName, Price)" & vbCrLf
sSQL = sSQL & "            WHERE Price > @varPrice" & vbCrLf
sSQL = sSQL & " ORDER BY Price DESC" & vbCrLf
sSQL = sSQL & " FOR XML AUTO, TYPE, ROOT ('Products')" & vbCrLf
sSQL = sSQL & "   END;" & vbCrLf
sSQL = sSQL & "-- Execute stored procedure" & vbCrLf
sSQL = sSQL & "EXECUTE TestProcedureName 1.50;" & vbCrLf

sSQL = Replace(Replace(sSQL, vbCrLf, vbLf), vbCr, vbLf)
arr_str_command = Split(sSQL, ";", , vbTextCompare)
iCount = UBound(arr_str_command)
If iCount = 0 Then
    sSQL = sSQL & ";"
    GoTo ContinueRst
End If

'Avoid additional element when we have ";" at the end
If Not CBool(Len(Trim(Replace(arr_str_command(UBound(arr_str_command)), vbLf, "")))) Then
    b = 1
End If

Dim cn As ADODB.Connection
Set cn = New ADODB.Connection
cn.CursorLocation = adUseServer
'https://www.w3schools.com/asp/prop_rec_mode.asp
'cn.Mode = 1 'Read-only
cn.CommandTimeout = 60
cn.Open sCn
'MsgBox cn.ConnectionString

Dim rst As ADODB.Recordset
Set rst = New ADODB.Recordset

Dim cmd As ADODB.Command
Set cmd = New ADODB.Command
Set cmd.ActiveConnection = cn

For i = 0 To UBound(arr_str_command) - b
    sLineSQL = ""
    sSQL = arr_str_command(i)
    If i > 0 Then
        If Left(sSQL, 1) = vbLf Then sSQL = Mid(sSQL, 2)
    End If
    If Trim(sSQL) = "" Then
        If bDbg Then MsgBox i & vbTab & "GoTo ContinueLoop"
        GoTo ContinueLoop
    Else
        sSQL = sSQL & ";"
    End If
    arr_str_lines = Split(sSQL, vbLf, , vbBinaryCompare)
    For l = 0 To UBound(arr_str_lines)
        'Detecting SQL command start
        sLine = Trim(arr_str_lines(l))
        If Left(sLine, 1) = vbLf Then sLine = Mid(sLine, 2)
        If Len(sLine) > 2 And Not Left(sLine, 2) = "--" And Not Left(sLine, 2) = "/*" Then
            sLineSQL = sLine
            Exit For
        End If
    Next l

    If Not sLineSQL = "" Then
        If StrComp(Left(sLineSQL, 4), "WITH", vbTextCompare) = 0 Then sSQL = ";" & sSQL

        If InStr(1, sSQL, "DECLARE", vbTextCompare) > 0 Or InStr(1, Left(sLineSQL, 5), "EXEC", vbTextCompare) > 0 Then
            For j = i + 1 To UBound(arr_str_command) - b
                sSQL = sSQL & vbLf & arr_str_command(j) & ";"
            Next j
            GoTo ContinueRst
        End If
        If i = UBound(arr_str_command) - b Then
            GoTo ContinueRst
        End If

        cmd.CommandText = sSQL
        'For statements that don't return records, execute the command specifying that it should not return any records
        'this reduces the internal work, so makes it faster
        cmd.Execute , , adCmdText + adExecuteNoRecords
        'Another option
        'sSQL = "____"
        'cn.Execute sSQL, RecsAffected
        'Debug.Print RecsAffected
        If bDbg Then Debug.Print "### " & i & vbTab & UBound(arr_str_command) - b & vbTab & Replace(sSQL, vbLf, "")
        Debug.Print "-- Command" & vbCrLf & sSQL
        If bDbg Then MsgBox i & vbTab & UBound(arr_str_command) - b & vbCrLf & sSQL

        If bDbg Then
            SoundName = "C:\WINDOWS\Media\Chimes.wav"
            PlayWavSound SoundName, 1
        End If
    End If
ContinueLoop:
Next i

ContinueRst:
If bDbg Then MsgBox "Recordset SQL:" & vbCrLf & sSQL
Debug.Print "-- Recordset SQL" & vbCrLf & sSQL

If bDbg Then
    On Error Resume Next
    If Not cn Is Nothing Then
        If cn.State = adStateOpen Then
            Debug.Print "-- Existe objecto cn y está abierta"
        Else
            Debug.Print "-- Existe objecto cn pero está cerrada"
            GoTo CleanUp
        End If
    Else
        Debug.Print "-- No existe objeto cn"
        GoTo CleanUp
    End If
    If Not tblOut Is Nothing Then
        Debug.Print "-- Existe objeto tblOut"
    Else
        Debug.Print "-- No existe objeto tblOut"
        GoTo CleanUp
    End If
    If Not rst Is Nothing Then
        Debug.Print "-- Existe objeto rst"
    Else
        Debug.Print "-- No existe objeto rst"
        GoTo CleanUp
    End If
    On Error GoTo ExceptionHandling
End If

With rst
    .Open sSQL, cn, adOpenForwardOnly, adLockReadOnly, adCmdText
    'Recordset queda cerrado si pasamos un comando como DROP, INSERT, etc.
    If .State = 0 Then
        If bDbg Then MsgBox "rst .State = 0"
        MsgBox "https://stackoverflow.com/questions/28677262/recordset-closed-after-stored-procedure-execution" & vbCrLf _
            & "Based on similar question: “Operation is not allowed when the object is closed” when executing stored procedure" & vbCrLf _
            & "The most common reason of Operation is not allowed when the object is closed is that that stored procedure does not contain SET NOCOUNT ON command," & vbCrLf _
            & "which prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements.", vbInformation
        GoTo CleanUp
    End If
    If Not .EOF Then
        'If bDbg Then MsgBox .Fields(0).Value
        'Debug.Print .Fields(0).Value

        'load the XML document from a string into memory into the DOMDocument object
        xmlDoc.LoadXML (.Fields(0).Value)

        Set miStream = PrettyXML(xmlDoc, True)

        'Read the raw bytes
        Dim byteData
        byteData = miStream.Read(-1) ' -1 means read all bytes
        'Convert bytes to text
        strText = StrConv(byteData, vbUnicode)
        MsgBox strText

        Dim filename As String
        filename = ThisWorkbook.Path & "\my_file.xml"
        miStream.SaveToFile filename, 2
        miStream.Close

        .Close
        SoundName = "C:\WINDOWS\Media\Chimes.wav" 'ir_begin  Chimes
        PlayWavSound SoundName, 1
    Else
        .Close
        GoTo CleanUp
    End If
End With

CleanUp:
    On Error Resume Next
    If Not cn Is Nothing Then
        If cn.State = adStateOpen Then cn.Close
    End If
    'https://codereview.stackexchange.com/questions/143895/making-repeated-adodb-queries-from-excel-sql-server
    '... get rid of the redundant assignments to Nothing; the objects are going out of scope at End Sub, they're being destroyed anyway.
    'Set rst = Nothing
    Exit Sub
ExceptionHandling:
    MsgBox "Error: " & Err.description
    Resume CleanUp
    Resume 'for debugging
End Sub

Function PrettyXML(Doc As DOMDocument60, Optional ByVal EmitXMLDeclaration As Boolean) As ADODB.Stream
    'https://stackoverflow.com/questions/29252587/mxxmlwriter60-ignores-encoding-property
    'https://stackoverflow.com/questions/2596085/saving-xml-in-utf-8-with-msxml
    'https://gist.github.com/atifaziz/8976460

    Dim reader As SAXXMLReader60
    Dim writer As MXXMLWriter60
    Set reader = New SAXXMLReader60
    Set writer = New MXXMLWriter60

    Dim objStream As Stream
    Set objStream = CreateObject("ADODB.Stream")
    'Dim objStream As Object
    'Set objStream = CreateObject("ADODB.Stream")
    With objStream
        .Charset = "utf-8"
        '.charset = "iso-8859-1"
        .Type = adTypeBinary
        .Open
    End With

    'Set writer settings
    With writer
        .indent = True
        .standalone = True
        .omitXMLDeclaration = Not EmitXMLDeclaration
        .Encoding = "utf-8"
        '.Encoding = "iso-8859-1"
        .byteOrderMark = False ' Set to False if you do not want a BOM
        .output = objStream
    End With

    'Connect reader to the writer
    Set reader.contentHandler = writer
    Set reader.dtdHandler = writer
    Set reader.errorHandler = writer

    Call reader.putProperty("http://xml.org/sax/properties/declaration-handler", writer)
    Call reader.putProperty("http://xml.org/sax/properties/lexical-handler", writer)

    'Parse the XML
    reader.Parse Doc

    'Return the result
    'PrettyXML = writer.output

    objStream.Position = 0
    Set PrettyXML = objStream
End Function
